412609.note: The bleed itself (Deep Wound), the only Deep Wounds id the sim registers; its 3 sec ticks land as 412613 in logs. Client 1.60.1.70009 and Classic Era agree: 4 ticks over 12 sec. The share of average weapon damage, 20/40/60%, is the talent 12834's curve. Beta logs (foreverlogs reports 33 and 35: Toro, Battle Slayer 38-58, and Peon, Forsaken Greataxe 49-74, both 11 Arms points so 1 point) put a lone bleed at 9 and 12-13 over 4 ticks, 20% of the weapon's average damage with no attack power (with it, 19 and 23). A crit on a running bleed adds what it still owed: Peon's 7/6/6/6 and 6/7/6/7 after two quick crits. The top rank holds at level 30 (foreverlogs 2705: Rinsy, 21 Arms points, Whirlwind Axe 102-154): 126 lone-bleed ticks of 17-20, mean 19.25, against 60% x 128 / 4 = 19.2; with attack power it would be about 37. Caster damage modifiers don't reach the ticks: 412613 carries Attributes[6] 0x20000000 (ignore caster damage modifiers, client 1.60.1.70205), and Rinsy's Defensive Stance ticks hold the Battle Stance level (2705: 15 ticks, 18.9; 2708: ticks from crits landed in Defensive Stance 19.3 over 9, vs 19.6 in Battle) while his Rend and Thunder Clap drop 9-13% there. So stances, Two-Handed Weapon Specialization, Death Wish and Enrage leave the bleed alone.
